help.title: Use Tara safely
help.lede: Prepare your sources, keep your private link, and follow processing through to the result.
help.inputs_body: Tara accepts MP3 or OGG tracks, an audio ZIP archive, or a merged YAML transcription when those modes are offered on the home screen.
help.link_body: The secret after the # character grants access to the job. It is not sent in request URLs. Do not publish this link, and rotate it if it was shared accidentally.
help.resume_body: You may close the page during upload or analysis. Return with the same link and select the requested file again to resume from the confirmed byte.
help.status_body: The page shows queueing, active stages, attempts, and recoverable errors. If the realtime stream is unavailable, Tara automatically falls back to periodic checks.
help.retention_body: Policy currently applied by this instance:
help.retention_session_body: Uploaded files remain available for 24 hours after the session is created. Explicitly cancelling the session triggers their deletion without waiting for the deadline.
help.retention_work_label: Sources and working files · 24 hours maximum
help.retention_work_body: Copies used by a job — source files, general context, previous summaries, raw transcription, and other intermediate files — expire no later than 24 hours after upload or creation.
help.retention_result_body: The final YAML summary remains available for 7 days after it is generated. Its exact expiry date and time are shown on the result page.
help.retention_delete_body: The job becomes inaccessible immediately. Its files are then removed by automatic cleanup, no later than their 24-hour or 7-day deadline.
help.retention_database_label: Database tracking records · no automatic purge yet
help.retention_database_body: After expiry, Tara currently retains session and job records: identifiers, the non-reversible fingerprint of the private link, statuses, dates, metrics, file names, associated people, general context, and previous summaries. This alpha limitation does not extend the file-retention periods listed above.
help.retention_cleanup_note: Cleanup runs every hour, so physical deletion may occur during the hour following a deadline. Always download or copy the result before the displayed date.
help.privacy_body: Only add necessary content. Public errors and technical logs do not include your text, secrets, or internal paths.
